note: Description taken from Silvestri's 1908 original description of Termes schultzei (in Latin), including the alate, the soldier and two classes of workers, large and small; type locality South Africa, Kalahari: Severelela, also from Kang-Kgokong. The name is now placed in the genus Allodontermes; the original reads Termes schultzei. The original is in Latin and the BHL scan was OCR'd: Roman and Arabic numerals are mixed (e.g. 'I' = 1), and decimal points are occasionally misread as commas. Blurred values are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Medium to rather large: alate 22 mm with wings and 10 mm without wings; soldier body length 4.2 mm, head length 1.75 mm; antennae 17-segmented (19-segmented in the alate), soldier head subrectangular, the mandibles well developed, very close to Termes vulgaris but differing in the shape of the head and mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Reddish yellow to yellowish brown, the head slightly darker, the ventral side slightly paler; wings hyaline, the wing scales, the costa, the subcosta and the veins at the base of the submedian all concolorous with the body. Head slightly longer than wide, the setae short and rather dense; compound eyes large and quite prominent; ocelli oval; frontal trace very small, circular. Antennae 19-segmented: segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2 and nearly as long as segment 4, segment 5 slightly shorter than segment 4. First mandibular tooth longer than the second. Pronotum nearly twice as wide as long, the lateral margins narrowing posteriorly, the posterior angles rounded obtuse, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly and shallowly concave. Wing surface densely covered with fine striae; venation of the fore and hind wings as figured. Abdominal setae rather numerous and short. Underside of the fore tibia with rather numerous and stout setae, the tip with 3 spurs. Measurements: body length (with wings) 22 mm, without wings 10 mm; fore wing length 19 mm; head width 1.40 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, the rest of the body straw yellow to cream (variegated by gut contents). Head subrectangular, the anterior and posterior angles slightly narrowed, one and a half times as long as wide (to the base of the labrum), the dorsum slightly convex and smooth. Labrum wide, slightly more than half the length of the mandibles, the anterior part subsquare, the tip obtuse, the lateral margins convex, the dorsum with 8 setae. Mandibles black except at the base, about twice the length of the head, the tips slightly upturned, the apices sharp; the right mandible with a large tooth in the anterior half, with a distinct deep notch behind the apical tooth; the left mandible with a fairly large triangular tooth at the position corresponding to that of the right mandible, with one small tooth before and one behind it. Antennae projecting forwards, slightly beyond the tips of the mandibles, slightly thickened towards the tip, 17-segmented: segment 3 shortest and slender, less than half the length of segment 2, slightly shorter than segment 4. Pronotum slightly wider than long, the middle of the anterior margin deeply notched, the sides broadly rounded obtuse, the lateral margins rounded, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; mesonotum smaller than the metanotum, the posterior margin broadly and shallowly concave. Legs long and rather slender, with numerous hairs, the upper inner side of the tibiae with several additional short spurs. Measurements: body length 4.2 mm; head length 1.75 mm; head width 1.18 mm; mandible length 0.86 mm; hind tibia length 1.0 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head reddish yellow, the rest of the body straw yellow (variegated by gut contents); head slightly wider than long (to the base of the mandibles); the postclypeus considerably inflated up to the base of the mandibles. Antennae 17-segmented, slightly thickened towards the tip; segment 3 shorter and more slender than the others, less than half the length of segment 2; segments 4 and 5 nearly equal in length. Body setae short, rather stout and sparse, the pleura additionally densely covered with very small setae. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum deeply notched, the sides broadly rounded obtuse. Legs long and rather slender, with long and short sparse setae. Abdomen oval, the cerci short, slender and hairy. Measurements: body length 3.5 mm; head width 1.3 mm; antennal length 1.75 mm; hind tibia length 1.00 mm. Small worker: head reddish yellow to yellowish white, abdomen cream, antennae 17-segmented; measurements: body length 2.2 mm; head width 0.9 mm; antennal length 1.6 mm; hind tibia length 0.9 mm.
